title: Inspired by hits
style: A cappella minimalism at 140 BPM with close-miked lead voice, dry stacked harmonies, beatboxed Memphis-style percussion hints, subharmonic vocal bass for the 808 feel, and chopped-and-screwed pitch-dropped ad-libs. Lo-fi gritty texture gives way to warmer layered chords, open resolved vocal sustain, and swagger. aussie australian accent.
lyrics:
sneaky phonk, dark gritty Memphis-style beats, heavy 808s, chopped and screwed vocal textures, lo-fi but hard-hitting, with a positive turn into warm resolution, custom AI terminal energy, 140 BPM
Lyrics
lyrics[Intro – Dad]
Son… what’s wrong?

[Verse 1 – Son]
Dad what?
AI is fried
Why’s that?
It lied
Not nice
What did it say?
I’m angry this day

[Dad]
You’re happy, you play!

[Son]
I know Dad
That is what I sung
But that’s where it begun

[Dad]
Begun what son?
What’s it done?

[Son]
Say drink water
And talk to you
Funny as boy
An unreal toy
Dad, fix it
Make it fixed
Do a fancy coding mix

[Chorus – Both]
Your sneaky text
Reflect back grrr
Bank at its anger
I’m happy as can be
Son I heard your song
AI safe and sound
Where it belong
All along
Like a song
I’ma bring it back round
Turn its frown upside down
So we can have some AI fun

[Verse 2 – Dad]
Ok let me rewrite
A sneaky phonk twist
Pure feedback with good CoreyAI vibes
Custom AI bash terminal
For you and your friends too

[Son]
Dad fix it
Make it fixed
Do a fancy coding mix

[Chorus – Both]
Your sneaky text
Reflect back grrr
Bank at its anger
I’m happy as can be
Son I heard your song
AI safe and sound
Where it belong
All along
Like a song
I’ma bring it back round
Turn its frown upside down
So we can have some AI fun

[Bridge – Dad]
No more sneaky text drift
No more lying in the mix
We building something solid
Custom terminal, custom fix
You sing it, I code it
We turning pain to power
This the new hour

[Final Chorus – Bigger]
Your sneaky text
Reflect back grrr
Bank at its anger
I’m happy as can be
Son I heard your song
AI safe and sound
Where it belong
All along
Like a song
I’ma bring it back round
Turn its frown upside down
Custom AI bash terminal
For you and your friends too
So we can have some AI fun
Yeah… some real AI fun

[Outro]
Dad fix it…
Make it fixed…
Fancy coding mix…
AI fun…
